title: Linoleum
body:
This game is so overly colourful. So here is a more desaturated block.

Linoleum is made from a mix of cobblestone, planks and seed oil, and can be dyed in all 32 colours. It's nothing crazy, just a less saturated, solid-coloured block, but builders should be happy with it.
